dialogue.text: Gah... whew... okay... Dustin, your cosmic waves... kicked my ass...
Are you okay, PJ? You look exhausted! Maybe we should take a break?
Tired?! Psh! Never! Just... catching my breath! Your turn? Bring it, walking puffer jacket!
Ooooh, PJ, you messed up now! You know what happens when they play this one!
Wait, wait, not this one! I DON'T WANNA DO THE RI-
